Meet AlMejarra

We love collaboration, because differences spark creativity.

That belief is why we set out to build an environment where coworking, shared ideas and shared knowledge blend together: a place that helps people find solutions and encourages innovation.

We founded AlMejarra (“the Galaxy”) as a coworking space and community hub: calm, comfortable and equipped with the tools you need to work or study at your best. Most importantly, you will meet professionals from many fields who are ready to swap ideas and grow their networks.

Our vision

The best work environment and community in Sharqia, supporting geeks, freelancers and entrepreneurs.

Our mission

Support youth groups, initiatives, freelancers and entrepreneurs with a shared workspace and with learning, mentoring and networking opportunities, so they can discover their potential, develop their communities across Sharqia and connect with the world.

Spaces

Choose your orbit

Four spaces in Zagazig for every way of working: a coworking desk, a training and meeting room, a private office and an event space.

01 / 04
Open coworking

The Space

A generous room overlooking the gardens around us, with sunlight and a fresh breeze. Carefully chosen IKEA desks and chairs and a distinctive interior make it a great place to work, study, read or meet your colleagues.

  • Fast free Wi-Fi
  • Drinks & snacks all day
  • Printer & scanner
  • IKEA furniture & bean bags
02 / 04
Training & meeting roomUp to 40 people

The Shuttle

A room equipped for talks, meetings and workshops that seats up to 40 people. Food and drinks are available on request.

  • Projector & sound system
  • Fixed & mobile whiteboards
  • Wi-Fi internet
  • Catering on request
03 / 04
Private office

The Capsule

A dedicated space for founders and freelancers: a private desk with more privacy than the rest of the space. We also help you with online marketing through AlMejarra and give you every tool we can for your project to succeed, because your success is ours.

  • Private, dedicated desk
  • High-speed internet
  • Equipped kitchen
  • Marketing support
04 / 04
Event spaceUp to 60 guests

The Planet

When an idea outgrows a room, the whole space becomes a venue for up to 60 guests: community meetups, hackathons, demo days and bootcamps.

  • Up to 60 guests
  • Events & meetups
  • AV equipment
  • Support from our team

Mission log

From the Big Bang to a new launch

  1. Aug 25, 2014

    The beginning

    We started the AlMejarra journey and began preparing the first coworking space in Sharqia.

  2. Jan 12, 2015

    Launch

    AlMejarra lifted off from its first home in 10th of Ramadan City.

  3. Mar 2015

    The Big Bang

    The official opening, at an event called “The Big Bang”.

  4. Dec 2015

    A new launch

    We opened AlMejarra in University Villas, Zagazig, with an event called “A New Launch”, then closed the 10th of Ramadan branch and settled in Zagazig.

  5. Today

    Still orbiting

    The first community for geeks, freelancers and entrepreneurs in Sharqia, and still growing.

AlMejarra astronauts

Owners & founders

Ahmed Fares launched AlMejarra with its first crew; Amr Herzo and Waleed Abdelhamid later joined as founders.

Founder & Co-owner

Ahmed Fares

Web UI designer and developer focused on mobile UX. He sees entrepreneurship as a way of life and wants AlMejarra to leave a mark and spread knowledge everywhere.

Co-founder & CEO

Amr Herzo

SAP consultant passionate about business intelligence and big data. He believes opportunities are made more than they are found, and in teamwork and community.

Co-founder

Waleed Abdelhamid

Independent lawyer and legal counsel to several companies. He believes in independent work and community, and that commitment to value and quality drives success.

Everything you want to know

Frequently asked

We started the AlMejarra journey on August 25, 2014, and launched on January 12, 2015 in 10th of Ramadan City, with an official opening event called “The Big Bang” in March 2015. In December 2015 we opened in Zagazig with an event called “A New Launch”, then closed the 10th of Ramadan branch; Zagazig has been our home ever since.
